explanation: The function `normalize_names` takes a list of strings as input. It initializes an empty set `normalized` to store unique, normalized names. It then iterates over each name in the input list, trims whitespace and converts it to lowercase using the `strip()` and `lower()` methods, respectively. Each normalized name is added to the set. After processing all names, the set is converted back to a list and returned. This approach ensures that duplicates are removed while preserving the order of the first occurrence of each normalized name.
